column29: After controlling for block one covariates and comorbidity, the cytokines block was statistically significantly associated with only one neurocognitive domain: verbal memory (P = .01). Specifically, the three cytokines simultaneously explained 6.0% of the variance in memory performance. In post-hoc analyses, sTNF-RII was the only cytokine that was statistically significant as an independent predictor for memory (P = .01), with higher levels predicting lower memory. B = -13.87, 95% CI = -26.77 to -0.96, P = .04 in cancer patients.
